//: Idea #22 — the `settlements:` POPULATION MACRO. The compact `settlements` block at the bottom macro-expands (pass 0, like `skillTrees:`) into the low-level records every build pass already handles: for each resident an ACHR placement + 2–3 schedule packages bound to the author's anchor refs (home bed / work station / wander marker) + settlement-faction membership + (optional) a vendor FACT and a placed merchant chest. NO new record type, NO runtime script — pure data expansion, fully verifiable offline. Compare examples/vendor_spec.json (one merchant, hand-authored) and examples/package_spec.json (one schedule package, hand-authored): the macro produces the same kind of records, in bulk.
//anchors: ANCHOR PHILOSOPHY: home/work/spawnAt are editorIds of refs YOU place (here: XMarkerHeading 0x34 markers + the floor grid). The macro only BINDS packages to them; it never conjures abstract sandbox points. Place a bed/forge/marker in the Godot editor (or here), give it an editorId, and the routine wires to it. In a custom cell with no real bed furniture the Sleep package has nothing to actually lie on — for true in-game sleeping place a vanilla bed near the `home` marker, or build the settlement in a vanilla cell that already has beds.
